lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters forming approximately five distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a regular matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature along the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A localized distribution of high-luminance circular spots visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin located in the upper right quadrant of the frame.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, dark, trailing linear filament originating from the posterior ventral region, consistent with an external attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated high-contrast silhouettes swimming in close proximity to the ventral-lateral flank.
